E10
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事。

programme.desc: 侯文詠原著小說改編，兩段糾結的情感，交織出一場關於「選擇」的情愛旅程。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事。

programme.title: E20
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: E22
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.desc: 王世子被即將成為世子嬪的女人綁架後而發生的一系列故事，在每個瞬間都要拼上性命的逃亡路上，青春男女之間發生的波瀾萬丈，最終逃跑的故事。

programme.title: E7
programme.desc: 在絕望中，頂級男明星柳善宰是女粉絲任素唯一的精神支柱。但一天突如其來的惡耗──善宰不幸離世，令任素整個世界天翻地覆。一覺醒來卻發現自己回到了13 年前，和當時正值青春燦爛只知道游泳的善宰是同學時，便決心盡力拯救善宰，阻止未來發生的悲劇而孤軍奮戰。

programme.title: E14
programme.desc: 於前作結尾被殺的閔道赫還沒有死去，於是決定向偽裝成整容後的Matthew，實際是被稱作「K」的盛燦集團繼承人報仇。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 在100年後的2125年，當時已有10萬人移民到火星，一個擁有未知力量的神秘物體出現，開啟了一個新時代。 22歲視障女孩「Lili-E1102」，自幼在火星成長，經過嚴苛的訓練都只是為了與一位特別的人相見──居住在地球、隸屬於ISDA（行星間宇宙開發組織）的年輕職員白石蒼人。 兩人之間曾立下了一個尚未告訴任何人的約定。然而，就在那一天，Lili卻被捲入了一場改變命運的重大事件之中。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.desc: 在100年後的2125年，當時已有10萬人移民到火星，一個擁有未知力量的神秘物體出現，開啟了一個新時代。 22歲視障女孩「Lili-E1102」，自幼在火星成長，經過嚴苛的訓練都只是為了與一位特別的人相見──居住在地球、隸屬於ISDA（行星間宇宙開發組織）的年輕職員白石蒼人。 兩人之間曾立下了一個尚未告訴任何人的約定。然而，就在那一天，Lili卻被捲入了一場改變命運的重大事件之中。

programme.title: E3 - The Giant
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: Boss Shark
programme.desc: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.title: E1 - Food, Glorious Food
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: E2 - Love Bites
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: The National Dog Show ('20)
programme.desc: From the Kennel Club of Philadelphia, this cherished competition for all dog lovers returns for the 17th year. Hosted by John O'Hurley, the event features 2,000 of the nation's leading canines, including the world’s largest, smallest and most exotic. Over 170 breeds strut their stuff with the hope of becoming this year's top dog. “The Dean” David Frei provides expert show commentary, and Mary Carillo chimes in as an adept sideline reporter for this ultimate canine showdown. But which dog will have their day, and which will leave with their tail between their legs? After all, there can only be one “Best in Show”.

E4 - Highlight 4
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. Crouch recovery Incident Manager Steve must work out how to get the vehicle upright without being able to close the whole road – a tricky challenge indeed! Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

programme.title: E6 - Sting Operation
programme.desc: Billy and Beekeeper Ian extract a bee colony from a family home, then Billy has to dodge talons and beak to remove a Great Horned Owl from a house.

programme.title: E1 - Copi
programme.desc: Considered a nuisance and trash fish, the Asian carp has overtaken the Illinois River's biomass and now outcompetes native species. Lucky for Yia, fishermen Clint Carter and Dave Buchanan have devised an ingenious way to rebrand this delicious fish by calling it Copy. Copy is now finding its way into restaurants across the country and Yia gets treated to a shore lunch after his day on the water.

programme.title: Save this Shark S1E2
programme.desc: 3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E16 -Ancient Horseshoe Crab, Swimming with Alligators & Tokay Gecko Bite!
programme.desc: Coyote finds a horseshoe crab, swims with alligators, and gets bitten by an invasive gecko!

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia S3E2 -Northern Territory
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S2E8 -Eco Innovators
programme.desc: Eco-innovators introduce Zac and Darin to unique and cost-effective ways to address complex problems and help heal the environment.

programme.title: Dongji Rescue
programme.desc: DONG JI ISLAND follows the tragic tale of a Japanese warship secretly transporting British prisoners of war and mistakenly attacked near the easternmost waters of China. To rescue the desperately trapped prisoners, a group of courageous islanders embark on a perilous journey against all odds to the sinking ship, facing relentless Japanese soldiers and the harsh, unforgiving seas...

programme.title: One Win
programme.desc: Woo-jin's win rate as a coach is less than 10%! Dismissed, expelled, bankrupt, kicked out, divorced...Even in life, he's experiencing defeat after defeat. Then, Pink Storm, a pro volleyball team that is on the brink of disbanding, brings him on as their coach. Pink Storm's ace players have all transferred to another team, so it's currently a team of leftovers. Jung-won buys the team even though the players have no skills and no teamwork. Jung-won, who is obsessed with creating a heartwarming story of losers' growing pains, pledges to give away a total of $2 million if Pink Storm wins just once. Pink Storm becomes the center of attention, but they keep losing. Woo-jin is used to losing, but he still gets frustrated. Even though the players lack experience and potential, he starts to desire one win...
